    static double
    MinimumRiskMovement.bulletRisk(Point2D.Double p, Point2D.Double me, List<VirtualBullet> bullets, long now)
    The virtual bullets' danger on the way to p: Hadur drives there in a straight line, and at each of MinimumRiskMovement.ROUTE_SAMPLES points along it a bullet that passes within MinimumRiskMovement.HIT_RADIUS within MinimumRiskMovement.HIT_WINDOW ticks of Hadur being there, widened by the uncertainty of the shot's fire tick, is a hit.
